title: Multi-currency expenses
pr_description: Lets users record expenses in a currency other than USD. Adds a currency column (default USD) and a currency parameter to add_expense, with a test covering the new parameter. Reporting is unchanged.

defects.anchor: def add_expense(db, user_id, amount_cents, category, spent_on, note="", currency="USD"):
defects.description: reports.monthly_summary and budget_status (not touched by this PR) SUM amount_cents across ALL currencies, so once a user records one EUR expense their totals, budgets and alerts silently add euros to dollars. The PR must not ship until aggregation is currency-aware.

currency is stored without any validation, unlike category which is checked against VALID_CATEGORIES two lines up. Any string ('usd', 'EURO', '💶') is accepted, fragmenting future per-currency grouping.

The added test only checks the currency round-trips on a single expense. Nothing exercises what happens to monthly_summary/budget_status with mixed currencies — exactly the interaction this PR breaks.
